name: rewoo
context: Cost-conscious tool workflows: all tool calls are planned upfront in one pass as a plan of expressions, then executed without interleaved LLM reasoning.
tradeoffs: Brittle when observations invalidate later plan steps
Solver quality depends on plan coverage
component_types: Optional specialized Solver LLM (smaller/faster model for final synthesis)
anti_patterns: Re-planning inside the loop (that is ReAct again)
Dependency on observation quality: plan execution fails silently when tool outputs are ambiguous
Planner-executor split adds latency for tasks where fast reactivity is needed
design_principles: Plan once, execute twice (tool pass, then solve pass)
Annotate estimated cost per step for DAG optimization
best_practices: Fall back to ReAct on solver failure
Execute independent tool calls in parallel using topological sort
Validate #E references with linter before execution (check cycles, resolution, tool existence)
Trigger re-plan when observation quality is surprising
references: Xu et al., ReWOO: Decoupling Reasoning from Observations, 2023 — https://arxiv.org/abs/2305.18323
